purpose: Teach: 明子/大介/康弘/ナターシャ/ミミ/目新しい/マジメ/思ひ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、隣のクラスの明子と話してたな
lines.en: I saw you talking to Akiko from the next class over.
lines.style: Playful accusation, light teasing lilt. Leans forward slightly. Not quite a smile yet, but the setup for one. Waiting to see him react.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、サッカー部の大介先輩を尊敬してたな、桜
lines.en: Oh, so you respected Daisuke senpai from the soccer team, huh Sakura.
lines.style: Flat return serve, eyes steady. Unflustered, slightly amused at being called out. Slow delivery on the opening phrase — measured retaliation.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のお父様、康弘さんって名前だったよな
lines.en: Your dad's name is Yasuhiro, right?
lines.style: Switching tactics, casual observation. Softer now, genuine curiosity underneath. Light, testing whether he'll notice the shift in tone.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ロシア人留学生のナターシャと話してたな、桜
lines.en: So you were talking to Natasha, that Russian exchange student, Sakura.
lines.style: Mirror-back rhythm, steady and calm. A hint of a smile in the delivery. Not accusatory — just patient. Waiting for her to see she's been matched.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ペットの名前ミミちゃんって付けたな
lines.en: You named your pet Mimi, didn't you.
lines.style: Wry edge sharpens here. Small laugh behind the words. Raising an eyebrow. This one's a direct hit and they both know it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、文化祭で「目新しい企画」って言ってたろ、桜
lines.en: You said something about a 'fresh new idea' at the culture festival, didn't you Sakura.
lines.style: Pressing the advantage now. Quicker pace. Still no anger — just relentless. The rhythm of someone who's studied her carefully.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、マジメな生徒だって先生に褒められたな
lines.en: Your teacher praised you for being such a serious student.
lines.style: Softer landing. Genuine warmth breaking through. A small concession, almost affectionate. Not quite letting her off the hook, but the tone has shifted toward something kinder underneath.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、古文で「思ひ」、つまり「思い」の旧仮名習ったろ、桜
lines.en: You learned that old kana form in classical Japanese — the one for 'omoi' — didn't you Sakura.
lines.style: Closes with specificity and care. Quieter pace. The smile is there now, unmistakable. He's showing her he's been paying attention to the actual things about her.
